person.name: Aryan Kumar
person.role: AI Engineer · Earth Observation · LLM Agent Safety

missions.title: Prompt-injection robustness study
missions.description: LangGraph agent (Qwen via Groq) answering remote-sensing questions over Sentinel-2 NDVI, Sentinel-1 water extent and ERA5 rainfall for 6 Indian regions. 20 tasks, 5 injection styles (incl. Hindi), 2 defenses, 660 runs.
missions.result: 0 of 600 attacked runs led to a harmful action. Task success 96.5-100%.
missions.artAlt: Pixel art: a towering wall of ice at night with torches along the top, arrows stuck in the ice and a dark pine forest at its foot
missions.blurb: Prompt-injection robustness study. 600 attacked runs, none led to a harmful action. Task success 96.5–100%.

missions.title: ASHA Voice Logging Agent
missions.description: Multilingual (Hindi, English, Marwari) voice agent turning home-visit reports into structured health records. Sarvam Saaras v3 STT, LLM extraction, Supabase. Safety-first IMNCI triage with a deterministic, source-cited rules engine.
missions.artAlt: Pixel art: an unrolled parchment scroll with handwriting and a red wax seal, a quill and a lit candle on a wooden table
missions.blurb: Voice agent turning Hindi, English and Marwari home-visit reports into sealed, structured health records.
